# API reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

Every route the server registers (170), by feature. Paths are under `/api`. Sign in with a session cookie (`POST /api/auth/login`); the permission column is what your role needs (see `permissionFor` in `apps/server/src/auth/auth.ts`). Members-only engagements answer 404 to non-members, and archived engagements refuse changes (rules 9 and 16). Request schemas come from the Zod schemas in `@gh/shared`; the same is in `docs/api/openapi.json`.

## agent-testing

Testing the agents: golden runs against known right answers, and the Verifier, measured against people's judgement.

### `GET /api/agent-testing`

Permission: read. Registered in `apps/server/src/agent-testing/agent-testing-routes.ts`.

### `GET /api/agent-testing/runs/:id`

Permission: read. Registered in `apps/server/src/agent-testing/agent-testing-routes.ts`.

### `POST /api/agent-testing/runs`

Permission: manage_models. Registered in `apps/server/src/agent-testing/agent-testing-routes.ts`.

Body: checked by this schema in the handler:

```ts
z.object({ agent: z.enum(GOLDEN_AGENTS), providerId: z.string().uuid(), model: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120), withVerifier: z.boolean().default(false), engagementId: z.string().uuid().nullish(), mode: z.enum(['agentic', 'single']).default('agentic') })
```

### `GET /api/agent-testing/retrieval`

Permission: read. Registered in `apps/server/src/agent-testing/agent-testing-routes.ts`.

### `POST /api/agent-testing/cases`

Permission: manage_models. Registered in `apps/server/src/agent-testing/agent-testing-routes.ts`.

Body: `NewGoldenCase` (@gh/shared)

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `agent` | `risk_classifier`, `control_designer` | yes |
| `title` | string (min 3, max 160) | yes |
| `useCase` | object | yes |
| `tier` | string or null |  |
| `risks` | array of object |  |
| `expected` | object | yes |

### `DELETE /api/agent-testing/cases/:id`

Permission: manage_models. Registered in `apps/server/src/agent-testing/agent-testing-routes.ts`.

### `POST /api/agent-testing/labels`

Permission: manage_models. Registered in `apps/server/src/agent-testing/agent-testing-routes.ts`.

Body: `NewJudgeLabel` (@gh/shared)

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `risk`, `control`, `tier` | yes |
| `claim` | string (min 5, max 2000) | yes |
| `sources` | array of string |  |
| `human` | `good`, `bad` | yes |
| `note` | string (max 600) |  |

### `DELETE /api/agent-testing/labels/:id`

Permission: manage_models. Registered in `apps/server/src/agent-testing/agent-testing-routes.ts`.

### `POST /api/agent-testing/labels/import`

Permission: manage_models. Registered in `apps/server/src/agent-testing/agent-testing-routes.ts`.

### `POST /api/agent-testing/calibrate`

Permission: manage_models. Registered in `apps/server/src/agent-testing/agent-testing-routes.ts`.

### `POST /api/cards/:id/verify`

Permission: prepare. Registered in `apps/server/src/agent-testing/agent-testing-routes.ts`.

## agents

The AI agents: one file per agent, the agent loop and its read-only tools, the Use Case Planner, agent settings and the kill switch.

### `GET /api/engagements/:id/agents`

Permission: read. Registered in `apps/server/src/agents/agent-routes.ts`.

### `PATCH /api/agents/:id`

Permission: manage_agents. Registered in `apps/server/src/agents/agent-routes.ts`.

Body: `AgentPatch` (@gh/shared)

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string (min 2, max 60) |  |
| `enabled` | boolean |  |
| `route` | `all`, `high_only`, `not_minimal`, `p1_only`, `cat_decision`, `cat_chatbot`, `cat_agent`, `cat_generative`, `cat_analytics`, `cat_other` |  |
| `providerId` | string or null |  |
| `model` | string (min 1, max 120) |  |
| `effort` | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max` |  |
| `fallbackProviderId` | string or null |  |
| `fallbackModel` | string or null |  |
| `summary` | string (max 200) |  |
| `instructions` | string (max 8000) |  |
| `tools` | array of string |  |
| `maxCostUsd` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1000) |  |
| `timeoutMin` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 120) |  |
| `concurrency` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 8) |  |
| `mode` | `agentic`, `single` |  |
| `maxSteps` | integer (≥ 2, ≤ 20) |  |
| `selfCheck` | boolean |  |


Body: checked by this schema in the handler:

```ts
Thread.extend({ question: z.string().trim().min(2).max(2000), conversationId: z.string().uuid().nullish(), newConversation: z.boolean().optional(), page: z.object({ path: z.string().max(200), snapshot: z.string().max(20000).default('') }).nullish(), // v1.7: the browser's id for this question, so its live steps reach only the person asking. requestId: z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,40}$/).optional(), // v1.7.4: edit one of your questions: it and everything after it in the conversation are replaced by this one. replaceFrom: z.string().uuid().optional() })
```

## audit

The hash-chained audit log: writing entries in the same transaction as each change (rule 5), browsing and verifying the chain.

### `GET /api/audit`

Permission: read. Registered in `apps/server/src/audit/audit-routes.ts`.

Query: checked by this schema in the handler:

```ts
z.object({ q: z.string().max(200).optional(), actor: z.string().max(120).optional(), action: z.string().max(120).optional(), ip: z.string().max(60).optional(), from: z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/).optional(), to: z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/).optional(), page: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).default(1), pageSize: z.coerce.number().int().refine((n) => [25, 50, 100, 200].includes(n)).default(50), limit: z.coerce.number().int().optional() })
```

### `GET /api/audit/verify`

Permission: read. Registered in `apps/server/src/audit/audit-routes.ts`.
